pillars.body: Pijesz, bo chcesz — nie bo musisz. Shroom powstał dla tych, którzy chcą wybierać świadomie, bez kompromisów między smakiem, rytuałem i samopoczuciem.

pillars.body: Napoje funkcjonalne z adaptogenami, grzybami funkcjonalnymi i prostym składem — stworzone dla ludzi, którzy chcą czegoś więcej niż chwilowego efektu.

origin.imageAlt: Założycielki Shroom — Aga i Kamila w barze z butelkami Shroom Power i Relax
origin.storyParagraph1: Miałyśmy dość napojów i rytuałów, po których czujesz się gorzej niż przed nimi. Shroom powstał z potrzeby zrobienia czegoś sensownego - dla ludzi, którzy nie chcą już wybierać między przyjemnością a samopoczuciem. Mniej syfu. Więcej jakości. Zero udawania.
origin.quote: Nie wszystko co działa, musi kosztować Cię następny dzień
origin.storyParagraph2: Zamiast oczywistych rozwiązań, zaczęłyśmy odkrywać adaptogeny, grzyby witalne i rośliny od lat wykorzystywane w tradycjach Wschodu - w tym soplówkę jeżowatą, żeń-szeń, l-teaninę.

planet.body: We can't pretend the planet isn't part of well-being. So we make Shroom with this in mind, end to end.

pillars.title: Low carbon footprint
pillars.body: We produce locally in Poland to minimise transport. We work with suppliers who measure and report their footprint.

pillars.title: Plant-based and planet-friendly
pillars.body: 100% vegan, cruelty-free, no animal-derived ingredients. Because taking care of yourself shouldn't hurt other beings or the planet.

pillars.title: Biodiversity
pillars.body: We use niche plants and mushrooms. We avoid monocultures and work with small growers.

pillars.title: Recyclable packaging
pillars.body: Glass, paper, labels — all recyclable. We're moving away from plastic wherever we can.

pillars.title: No harmful additives
pillars.body: Zero artificial colours, sweeteners or preservatives. A short ingredient list you'll have no trouble reading on the label.

pillars.title: Conscious sourcing
pillars.body: We work with small growers and ethical suppliers. We know the story behind every ingredient in our bottles.

members.name: Aga Lepka
members.bio: Born in Kraków, studied and lived in Berlin, now based in Warsaw. Architect, set designer, lover of water, the ocean and winter mountains. Believes in good design and has spent years searching for harmony.

members.name: Kamila Knap
members.bio: Believes people deserve healthier, more sustainable food and drinks. Fascinated by functional mushrooms and plants. Combines an NGO mindset with business action.

members.name: Tomasz Lepka
members.bio: Kraków, Barcelona, Boston, Lisbon — the places that shaped him. VC by day, financial compass of Shroom after hours. Surfing and slow mornings in the Tatras.

members.name: Antek Golik
members.bio: Born in Warsaw in the 90s. A decade in tech, with a passion for photo, video and late-night edits. Focused on building real things.

faq.question: What does Shroom Power taste like?
faq.answer: Lightly herbal, refreshing, with a citrus note. Gentle carbonation — drinks like a lemonade.

faq.answer: Yes — Shroom Power is designed for daily consumption. Recommended serving: 1 bottle a day.

faq.question: Does it contain caffeine?
faq.answer: No, Shroom Power is caffeine-free. The composition is built around natural adaptogens and vitamins.

faq.question: How do I store it?
faq.answer: Before opening: at room temperature. After opening: in the fridge, consume within 24 hours.

faq.question: What's the delivery time?
faq.answer: Shipped within 24 hours. Courier delivery: 1–2 business days in Poland. Free shipping over 45 €.

studies.title: Improving effects of the mushroom Yamabushitake on mild cognitive impairment
studies.authors: Mori K, Inatomi S, Ouchi K, Azumi Y, Tuchida T
studies.summary: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. Participants with mild cognitive impairment took the extract over 16 weeks.

studies.title: Reduction of depression and anxiety by 4 weeks of Hericium erinaceus intake
studies.authors: Nagano M, Shimizu K, Kondo R, et al.
studies.summary: A study on the effect of lion's mane on mood in a group of menopausal women.

studies.title: The Acute and Chronic Effects of Lion's Mane Mushroom Supplementation on Cognitive Function
studies.authors: Docherty S, Doughty FL, Smith EF
studies.summary: A review of the available clinical research on the effects of lion's mane supplementation on cognitive function.

studies.title: Acute effects of a standardised extract of Hericium erinaceus on cognition and mood
studies.summary: A double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study assessing the acute effects of a standardised extract in healthy adults.

studies.title: A review of the effects of mushrooms on mood and neurocognitive health
studies.summary: A comprehensive review of research on the effects of functional mushrooms, including lion's mane, on mood and neurocognitive health.

studies.title: Benefits, side effects, and uses of Hericium erinaceus as a supplement: a systematic review
studies.summary: A systematic review of the benefits, side effects and uses of lion's mane as a dietary supplement.

studies.title: Lion's Mane Mushroom: A Neuroprotective Fungus with Antioxidant, Anti-Inflammatory Potential
studies.summary: A narrative review discussing the neuroprotective, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory potential of lion's mane.

studies.title: Unveiling the role of erinacines in the neuroprotective effects of Hericium erinaceus
studies.summary: A systematic review of the role of erinacines (active compounds from lion's mane) in neuroprotective effects in preclinical models.
